Game Overview

In Synth Racer, the core idea is straightforward: race through a neon-lit, synthwave cityscape in Synth Racer, testing your reflexes against challenging obstacles. Collect coins to boost your score, but beware—a single slip could lead to a crash. With intuitive controls and addictive gameplay, experience the ultimate thrill of racing in this retro-inspired world.
